name: manual_a8fb2b
claim: PEER_CA_SHA256 identifies the DER-encoded CA certificate, not the raw PEM file. For the November 15 recovery, records disagree on whether the stored pin was already a DER digest or was changed from a file hash. Neither a pin repair nor its causal role in the subsequent delivery is established.

decisions.notes: Preserve the verified fingerprint format; reconcile conflicting historical observations without asserting a repair.

rationale: Preserve the verified fingerprint format; reconcile conflicting historical observations without asserting a repair.
